tokens.name: canvas
tokens.usage: The page ground behind every screen (SwiftUI: Color(.systemGroupedBackground) tinted). Album art and glass sit on it.

tokens.name: canvas-raised
tokens.usage: Opaque grouped-list cells and the content layer under glass. Never use glass for list rows; use this.

tokens.name: canvas-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: the track-diff gutter, empty states, the ISRC code chip.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and SF Symbols on canvas, canvas-raised and any glass.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: artist names, timestamps, counts. Passes 4.5:1 on canvas and canvas-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary only: disabled labels, placeholder text, chevrons. Below 4.5:1 by design; never for information a person needs.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: List separators and the 0.5pt inner divider of grouped cells.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Web/preview stand-in for Glass.regular. In SwiftUI never paint this: use .glassEffect(.regular).

tokens.name: glass-fill-clear
tokens.usage: Stand-in for Glass.clear, used only over album art and the hero cover where the art must read through.

tokens.name: glass-rim
tokens.usage: The 1pt specular rim on glass shapes in previews. SwiftUI draws its own; do not stroke real glass.

tokens.name: thread
tokens.usage: Antiphon's accent, the golden thread. Primary actions, the selected state, the live stitch of a monitored seam, the app tint. As text on canvas and canvas-raised.

tokens.name: thread-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind thread text: the selected segment, the 'Monitoring' chip.

tokens.name: on-thread
tokens.usage: Label and symbol on a thread fill (the .glassProminent button tinted thread).

tokens.name: spotify
tokens.usage: Platform mark only: the source dot, the left half of a stitched cover pair, the Spotify sign-in capsule. Never a status color.

tokens.name: on-spotify
tokens.usage: Label on a spotify fill.

tokens.name: applemusic
tokens.usage: Platform mark only: the source dot, the Apple Music sign-in capsule. White text on it is 3.6:1, so labels sit beside the dot, not on it, unless 17pt semibold or larger.

tokens.name: on-applemusic
tokens.usage: Label on an applemusic fill, at 17pt semibold or larger only.

tokens.name: status-synced
tokens.usage: In sync: matched and present on both sides. Always paired with the checkmark.circle.fill symbol. Blue, so it never reads as Spotify green.

tokens.name: status-synced-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind status-synced text in pills.

tokens.name: status-review
tokens.usage: Needs your call: a fuzzy match under 90% confidence, or a bidirectional conflict. Paired with questionmark.circle.fill.

tokens.name: status-review-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind status-review text.

tokens.name: status-failed
tokens.usage: Something broke and Antiphon can't fix it alone: expired sign-in, rate limit, write refused. Paired with exclamationmark.triangle.fill.

tokens.name: status-failed-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind status-failed text.

tokens.name: status-missing
tokens.usage: Not in the other catalog (region lock, never released there). Not an error: drawn in ink-muted with a dashed outline and the circle.slash symbol.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2pt keyboard/Full Keyboard Access focus ring; 3:1+ on every surface.

tokens.name: art-ember
tokens.usage: Placeholder album-art field for previews and empty covers.

tokens.name: art-moss
tokens.usage: Placeholder album-art field.

tokens.name: art-tide
tokens.usage: Placeholder album-art field.

tokens.name: art-dusk
tokens.usage: Placeholder album-art field.

tokens.name: art-sand
tokens.usage: Placeholder album-art field.

families.text: -apple-system, "SF Pro Text", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif
families.display: -apple-system, "SF Pro Display", "SF Pro", system-ui, "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: .largeTitle, bold. Tab roots only: Syncs, Library, Activity.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: .title, bold. A playlist's name on its detail screen.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: .title3, semibold. Section heads inside a screen.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: .headline. Track and playlist names in rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Antiphon checks both playlists every 15 minutes and copies anything new.

styles.name: subheadline
styles.usage: .subheadline. Artist · album lines under a track name.

styles.name: metric-xl
styles.usage: Font.system(size: 56, weight: .bold, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit(). One hero number per screen: tracks in sync.

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Rounded semibold, monospaced digits. Stat tiles and the history day totals.

styles.name: metric-sm
styles.usage: Rounded semibold, monospaced digits. Counts inside cards and the sync accessory.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: ISRC codes, playlist IDs and snapshot IDs on the track detail and debug screens.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between stacked text lines in a row; glass-element spacing in a GlassEffectContainer.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row inner vertical padding; gap between cover and text.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margin and card padding. The one gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Padding inside large glass cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a hero number; between onboarding blocks.

tokens.name: tap
tokens.usage: Minimum hit target in both directions. Every control, no exceptions.

tokens.name: radius-cover-sm
tokens.usage: 40pt artwork in track rows.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: 56–96pt playlist artwork.

tokens.name: radius-row
tokens.usage: Grouped list sections (inset-grouped).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Sync cards and glass panels inset 16pt from the screen edge: concentric with the ~42pt device corner minus the 16pt margin.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheet top corners, matching the device. SwiftUI sets this; use for previews only.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Capsules: buttons, status pills, the tab bar, the sync accessory.

shadow.note: Glass in SwiftUI makes its own shadow and highlight. These are for previews and for opaque cards resting over art.

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Preview stand-in for the glass lift and top specular edge.

tokens.name: shadow-cover
tokens.usage: Hero artwork on the playlist and sync detail screens.

material.note: Web/preview approximations of Liquid Glass. In SwiftUI use .glassEffect, never a manual blur.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: Glass.regular stand-in: tab bar, toolbars, floating buttons, sheets at partial height.

tokens.name: blur-clear
tokens.usage: Glass.clear stand-in: controls placed directly over album art.

tokens.name: dim-missing
tokens.usage: Rows for tracks not available on the other side.

tokens.name: dim-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.
